title: 第11章 抢劫第12章 神境之威
content_zh:
“太好了！”
林云见果然能买到这类书籍，眼神中顿时闪烁出兴奋的光芒，目光都变得火热起来。
“公子，您慢慢选着，等选完书，直接去前面柜台结账就行了。”
伙计面带微笑。
“好。”
林云也礼貌性地点头应答。
伙计在说完之后，便转身离开，去引导、服务其他客人。
林云的目光重新汇聚向面前书架。
这些书籍都被严实包裹，未曾开封，只有买下来之后才能翻阅。
所以林云在仔仔细细地看完一圈后，毫不迟疑地从书架上，一股脑拿了十七八本书籍。
“看完这些书籍，应该就能对宇宙海，有一个更全面的了解！”
林云心中满是期待。
在选完书之后，林云小心拿着这些书籍，快步走向付账的柜台。
自己如今在宇宙海中，还是个小白。
林云已经迫不及待，只想拿着这些书，随便找个安静的酒楼或者舒适的客栈，坐下来细细研读，去深入了解宇宙海。
柜台处。
前面还有三波客人在结账，林云便安静地排队等候着。
如果让这里的人知晓，一位堂堂神境强者，此刻竟老老实实地，在此处排队结账，想必他们定会万分震惊！
大约等了五六分钟后，终于轮到林云。
“麻烦结下账。”

林云将这些书籍，整齐地放置在柜台上。
林云丝毫不担心支付的问题。
毕竟从那黑斗袍男人手中，他不但收获了三千神晶，还获取了上千万的幽云宇宙国钱币。
这里也是幽云宇宙国统治下的星系，所以林云得到的这种货币，应该是在幽云宇宙国内通用的。
至于神晶，那可是非常珍贵的，想必买这些书籍，根本用不着神晶。
“好，稍等。”
柜台处结账的人，是一个年轻女子，长得颇有几分姿色，应该算是这家商会，用来充当门面的。
她应了一声之后，便拿起这些书籍，计价算账。
正为林云算账时，一名身着华贵服饰的年轻男子，从二楼踱步而下，行至柜台前。
“这些东西，给我结下账！”
这名年轻男子，大摇大摆的走到柜台前，将手中的物品，随意丢在柜台上。
“吕公子，我这就给您算账，您稍等。”
柜台前的女子，见到这位公子后，脸上瞬间堆满谄媚的笑容，态度恭敬至极，连声音都变成了夹子音。
她立马放下林云的书籍，转而给此人结账。
林云见此情形，眉头不由地微微皱起。
“喂，你已经在给我算账了，应当先给我算完才对，总要有个先来后到吧。”
林云脸上挂着几分不悦。
女子听到林云的抱怨，极其不耐烦地瞥了他一眼：
“你瞎嚷嚷什么？这位可是吕公子，能跟你一样？”
这位吕公子，目光也随之瞥向林云，满脸不屑地一笑：
content_en:
"Great!"
When Lin Yun saw that he could indeed buy such books, his eyes suddenly shone with excitement and his eyes became hot.
"Sir, please take your time to choose. When you finish selecting the book, just go to the front counter to pay."
The guy is smiling.
"Okay."
Lin Yun also nodded politely in response.
After the waiter finished speaking, he turned around and left to guide and serve other guests.
Lin Yun's eyes returned to the bookshelf in front of him.
These books are tightly wrapped and unopened, and can only be read after they are purchased.
So after Lin Yun read it carefully, he took seventeen or eight books from the bookshelf without hesitation.
"After reading these books, you should be able to have a more comprehensive understanding of the cosmic sea!"
Lin Yun was full of expectations.
After selecting the books, Lin Yun carefully took the books and walked quickly to the checkout counter.
I am still a novice in the universe sea.
Lin Yun couldn't wait. He just wanted to take these books, find a quiet restaurant or a comfortable inn, sit down and study them carefully, and get a deeper understanding of the universe sea.
At the counter.
There were three waves of customers in front of them checking out, so Lin Yun waited in line quietly.
If the people here knew that a powerful man in the divine realm was actually queuing up to check out here, they would definitely be extremely shocked!
After waiting for about five or six minutes, it was finally Lin Yun's turn.
"Please settle the bill."
Lin Yun placed these books neatly on the counter.
Lin Yun was not worried about payment at all.
After all, from the man in the black robe, he not only gained three thousand divine crystals, but also tens of millions of Youyun Universe Kingdom coins.
This is also a galaxy under the rule of Youyun Universe, so the currency Lin Yun received should be universal in Youyun Universe.
As for the divine crystal, it is very precious. You must buy these books without needing the divine crystal at all.
"Okay, wait a moment."
The person checking out at the counter was a young woman who was quite pretty. She should be considered the face of this chamber of commerce.
After she responded, she picked up the books and calculated the prices.
While Lin Yun was settling accounts, a young man in luxurious clothing walked down from the second floor and walked to the counter.
"Pay these items to me!"
The young man walked up to the counter in a swagger and casually threw the items in his hands on the counter.
"Master Lu, I will settle the accounts for you right now. Please wait a moment."
When the woman in front of the counter saw the young man, her face was filled with a flattering smile. Her attitude was so respectful that even her voice turned into a jingle.
She immediately put down Lin Yun's books and turned to pay the bill for this person.
Lin Yun couldn't help but frown slightly when he saw this situation.
"Hey, you are already settling the accounts for me. You should finish it for me first. There must be a first-come, first-served basis."
Lin Yun had a bit of displeasure on his face.
When the woman heard Lin Yun's complaint, she glanced at him extremely impatiently:
"What are you yelling about? This is Mr. Lu, can he be like you?"
Mr. Lu also glanced at Lin Yun and smiled with disdain:
